mapper.update: UPDATE pickup_request SET total_weight = #{totalWeight}, total_volume = #{totalVolume}, pickup_window_start = #{pickupWindowStart}, pickup_window_end = #{pickupWindowEnd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = 'OPEN'
